newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Cellular Technical started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Cellular Technical started.

text.p: -- ABN AMRO Chicago Corp said on Monday it initiated coverage of Cellular Technical Services Co with a buy rating and a price target of $19 a share.
-- Cellular Technical is trading 35 percent below levels seen at the end of 1996, with the stock being penalized for troubles in the fourth quarter that are now corrected ABN AMRO said.
-- ABN AMRO expects new contracts and new product announcements to drive the stock price higher, with a long-term growth rate of between 20 percent and 25 percent.
-- ABN AMRO set its earnings estimate for 1997 at $0.68 a share and the estimate for 1998 at $1.21.
-- Cellular Technical makes and markets fraud prevention systems for analog cellular service providers.
-- Its shares closed up 1/8 Monday at 13-5/8.
